decisions.reason: After four years and two years without visible prominence, this Magento-related template looks like a peripheral add-on whose uncertainty has largely resolved, so its remaining option value no longer clearly justifies ongoing maintenance and updates.

The responsive website template sits adjacent to rather than at the center of the firm's hosting-and-support strategy, and after several years with little visible evidence of traction management would reallocate resources to stronger core options.
Premium customer support reinforces the firm's agency-focused service differentiation and relies on existing support operations, so it remains a low-risk, strategically valuable offering to keep.

Scalable hosting for agencies is a close-to-core flagship line aligned with the firm's stated direction, growth, and technical base, so management would keep investing unless much clearer negative evidence appeared.
